candidate_reports.remark: An automated weather station reported zero visibility in dense blowing dust at Goodyear Municipal Airport. AWOS station KGYR at Goodyear Municipal Airport.
Trained spotter reported near zero visibility in dense blowing dust near West Camelback Rd on loop 101.
Ogilby Road closed due to flooding.
Westmoreland Road near Boley Road closed due to flooding with water overtopping a bridge.
State Route 111 flooded near the Riverside/Imperial County border with 2 vehicle stuck in the floodwaters reported.
Roadway flooding reported in the area of State Route 111 and Parkside Drive.
The area of Sea View Way and Dolphin Drive in North Shore reported flooded.
State Route 98 closed from Imperial Highway to Brockman Road due to flooding.
Highway 78 closed between Ogilby Rd and Clark Way due to flooding in multiple locations along the highway.
ADOT webcam on SR-347 at Cement Plant Rd shows a dust plume producing frequent visibility reductions less than 1/4_ causing major traffic backups.
Video of near zero visibility along SR-87 near Santan Rd.
